standard_prerequisites.name: D_QCoh of a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme has a perfect generator
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the assertion to perfect test objects E.

standard_prerequisites.name: Derived limits of quasi-coherent modules agree with R lim, and the functor R Hom_X(E, -) into D(R) commutes with products hence with derived limits
standard_prerequisites.use: Moves the limit out of the Hom.

standard_prerequisites.name: The dual perfect complex computes Hom, the base change lemma computes R Gamma of the dual tensor a pulled back module as a tensor product over R, and R Gamma(X, E^vee) is perfect for proper f with E perfect
standard_prerequisites.use: Translates each term into a tensor product of R-modules.

standard_prerequisites.name: A pseudo-coherent complex of modules tensored into a surjective inverse system satisfies the limit isomorphism, by the More on Algebra pseudo-coherent tensor limit lemma

core_obligations: Reformulate the statement as bijectivity of Hom(E, O_X tensor lim M_n) -> Hom(E, lim O_X tensor M_n) for all E in D_QCoh; by the perfect generator theorem it suffices to check perfect E (proof lines 7801-7807).
Use lemma-Rlim-quasi-coherent to replace the limit by R lim, and the product commutation of R Hom_X(E, -) to move the derived limit outside the Hom (proof lines 7808-7818).

Identify R Hom_X(E, O_X tensor M_n) with R Gamma(X, E^vee tensor^L Lf^* M_n) = R Gamma(X, E^vee) tensor^L M_n by the dual complex and the base change lemma; by the flat-proper perfect direct image lemma R Gamma(X, E^vee) is a perfect, in particular pseudo-coherent, complex of R-modules, and the pseudo-coherent tensor limit lemma exchanges R lim of the tensors with the tensor of the limit (proof lines 7820-7838).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to perfect test objects via the perfect generator (proof lines 7801-7807).
Move the limit outside the Hom with R lim and product commutation (proof lines 7808-7818).
Rewrite each term as a tensor product over R and conclude by the pseudo-coherent tensor limit lemma (proof lines 7820-7838).
